$description: Canonical radius source. Hand-edit this file only; dist/ is generated.

meta.note: Five values in use, measured across the whole light artboard. They are not an arithmetic ramp, so they are recorded as observed rather than fitted to a formula.

sm.usage: Checkboxes. The only square-ish control in the system.

md.usage: Rare. Two decorative rectangles on the light artboard and nothing else. Confirm before relying on it; it may be incidental rather than intentional.

lg.usage: Inner tiles inside a card: transaction icon squares, avatar tiles, swatches.

pill.usage: Every interactive control — buttons, inputs, textareas, badges, tabs, switches, slider tracks and thumbs. At the system's control heights (20/28/32px) 18px exceeds half the height, so it renders as a true pill. This is the system's defining shape; using anything else on a control will look wrong.

xl.usage: Cards, panels, sheets, dialogs. The outer container radius.

full.usage: Circles: radio dots, avatars, status dots.

controlHeights.$note: Observed alongside the radii. Not yet tokens, but they are what makes 18px read as a pill.
